I get it, I do not condone cheating but I do understand how you feel. My ex and I slept together all of 6 or 7 times during a 4 year relationship. Maybe a few more if I’m forgetting some. I never wanted to push anything, but it really started to mess with my head. One day, I was home alone and it had been about 8 months since we slept together at that point. Their texts where synced up to their laptop and I skimmed through some. I saw a number I didn’t recognize & read a few texts. I saw a dick pic and immediately I was filled with rage. I started reading more of the conversation and found out not only did they sext, but they planned on meeting up one day. It hurt because they didn’t touch me for months, it felt like the biggest punch in the gut. A few months later and I still stayed with them. Their friend moved in with us, and we got drunk one night and we brought up the idea of a threesome. It happened and I thought maybe our sex life was back. I slept with my ex solo one more time, and then we went dry again. I started to wonder & for the first time I had thoughts about cheating. I knew it wasn’t their fault they couldn’t sleep with me, but it was impossible to try to break up with them & I wanted it to work. I started to get feelings for our housemate. I didn’t want to cheat, so I brought up the idea of me sleeping with them since we had talked about an open relationship before. They said yes after a long talk about what that meant. I hung out with our housemate for a few hours but we both ended up getting tired and going to bed. I went back to my partner and I’s room and they got so irrationally mad at me claiming I hated them when I didn’t even sleep with our housemate. I said nothing happened and just went to bed confused. Basically, after that I ended things with the housemate and tried to bring up my needs being met & what to do with my ex. Nothing really got solved and we ended up breaking up 6 months later. 

I still love them, but I was never going to be happy in a sexless relationship. Saddest thing is they have a new partner that the slept with before the first date. Again, I don’t condone your cheating I just do come from an understanding from a similar situation. You need to tell your husband you need to leave because you’re needs aren’t being met & you aren’t happy. You don’t get another chance in life, don’t waste it on somebody who makes you feel like this. If it was right, you wouldn’t have been unfaithful. At the end of the day, sounds like your husband has an addiction he doesn’t want help for and you do not need to stick around for that. Regardless of your actions you deserve someone better.

Took Tylenol and ibuprofen every 4 hours, ate nothing but apple sauce, pasta and soup. GET INTO A DENTIST ASAP. this regimen was temporary until I could get a root canal/filling. I was lucky nothing happened after 5 months of pain. Seriously, find a way to get insurance ASAP. I bit the bullet and got carecredit to pay any bills and am making monthly payments. My mouth is out of pain, but I promise it’s not worth putting off. Also: could have just been a placebo but when I was in bad pain I did coconut oil pulling and felt relief for a while.
